add_executable(manipulator_pick main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(manipulator_pick PRIVATE dyphur::core dyphur::scene)
add_sycl_to_target(TARGET manipulator_pick SOURCES main.cpp)

# Resolve Panda assets from the (committed) source tree, not the per-build copy:
# the .meshmap records absolute mesh paths for the viz tools, and a build-dir path
# would be ephemeral and build/config-specific (e.g. a trajectory generated by the
# CUDA build couldn't be replayed after switching to OMP).  The source assets are
# always present and identical across builds.
target_compile_definitions(manipulator_pick PRIVATE
    DYPHUR_MANIP_ASSET_DIR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets")
